query: How do I check the status of my passport application or retrieve the application reference number?
reference_answer: You may check the status of your online application or retrieve your application reference number by logging in to MyICA.For hardcopy applications, you may log in to our e-Service.
answer: To check the status of your passport application or retrieve the application reference number, visit the official government website or use their mobile app to log in with your personal details. [Document 1]
